metadata.name: brink_vaults
metadata.description: Brink fixed vaults: term series that place USDC at a venue and receive fixed on the Brink pool, so depositors hold a fixed APY to maturity

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Anyone cancels a series that nobody hedged within the grace after its window closed. The authority may
cancel earlier while the series is still subscribing. Deposits return 1:1 through `withdraw`.

instructions.name: create_series
docs: Creates a series on a pool and its venue. Upgrade authority only.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Subscribes USDC while the window is open; one share per USDC.

instructions.name: hedge
docs: Once the window has closed, anyone places the hedge: a receive-fixed swap for the notional the deposits
support, the rest placed at the venue. A series below its minimum cancels instead. The fixed rate the
swap commits the series to is never below the series' own floor, whatever limit the caller supplies
(external scan 2, finding 15): the floor is set when the series is created and published with it.

instructions.name: redeem
docs: Redeems shares pro rata for the settled USDC.

instructions.name: settle
docs: After maturity, anyone settles: the swap is settled if it is still open, the placement is redeemed, the
fee on the yield is split 50/50 to the treasury and the buyback escrow, and shares become redeemable.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Returns USDC 1:1 for shares while the series is subscribing or after it was cancelled.

types.name: Benchmark
docs: Benchmark account. The swap AMM reads this layout directly (owner-checked), so field order is frozen per
`version`; both programs upgrade together when it changes.
Space is declared by hand (`impl Space`) because the fixings ring is held in a `Box`: the account is about
2.7 KB and a by-value deserialisation of it needs two copies in one SBF stack frame, above the 4 KB frame
limit (the toolchain reports the overflow at build time). With the ring on the heap the struct is about 700
bytes on the stack and the ring is copied once, in its own frame. The wire layout is unchanged: a boxed array
serialises as the array.

fields.name: prev_value_bp
docs: Value held over the most recent accrual segment `[prev_unix_ts, unix_ts]` (maths finding M-2).

fields.name: prev_unix_ts
docs: Start of the most recent accrual segment; equals `unix_ts` until the second accepted value.

fields.name: max_drift_bp
docs: Drift bound (S-6): the value may move at most this far from `drift_anchor_bp` within one window.

fields.name: clamped
docs: The last accepted value was clamped by the band or the drift bound.

fields.name: disputed
docs: The last aggregation had a quorum of fresh observations that did not agree; the value was not moved.

fields.name: support
docs: Observations that supported the last accepted value. `1` means a single-publisher (devnet) registry.

fields.name: ema_milli_bp
docs: EMA at bp x 1 000 (maths finding M-6). `ema_bp` is `rhu(ema_milli_bp / 1 000)`; at most
`MAX_RATE_BP x 1 000`, so it fits `u32` and the `u16` narrowing of `ema_bp` cannot fail.

fields.name: fixing_first_day
docs: UTC day number (unix seconds / 86 400) of the oldest fixing ever written; 0 until the first midnight the
benchmark lives through.

fields.name: fixing_head_day
docs: UTC day number of the most recent fixing written.

fields.name: fixings
docs: Ring of `FIXING_DAYS` daily fixings: the cumulative accrual (`accrual_e18` units) at 00:00 UTC of day `d`
lives at byte offset `16 * (d % FIXING_DAYS)` as a little-endian `u128`. Written by `publish` for every
midnight a segment crosses; read by the AMM to settle a swap at its maturity whatever was published later
(ADR-006, review finding F-12, maths finding M-2, simulation finding S-3). Raw bytes rather than
`[u128; N]` so that loading the account is a copy, not a per-element decode; boxed so that copy is made
once, outside the account's own stack frame.

fields.name: ema_slot
docs: Slot at which the EMA last moved (or was confirmed equal to its input); the decay of the next step is
measured from here, not from the last publication (M-11).

fields.name: accepted_slot
docs: Slot of the transaction that last accepted a value. `slot` is the freshness of the data behind it (M-12);
this is when the benchmark itself last moved, used to widen the band after an outage.

fields.name: support_lost
docs: The observations behind the last accepted value no longer amount to a quorum of currently registered,
fresh publishers: set by `remove_publisher` and `set_publishers` for the benchmarks passed to them, by
`revalidate`, and by `publish` when fewer registered observations than the quorum are fresh. Degrades the
benchmark until the next accepted value clears it (external scan 2, finding 8).

types.name: BookSide
docs: One side of the open book: the four signed aggregates for one leg.

fields.name: min_fixed_bp
docs: The lowest fixed rate the hedge may commit the series to, in basis points.

types.name: HookFlags
docs: Hook points. Hooks observe and veto entries only (open, deposit); no exit (withdraw, cancel, settle,
liquidate) makes a hook CPI in any mode, so no hook can ever veto or starve an exit (review F-30, ADR-003).
The four retired exit points keep their slots so the layout and the point discriminators are stable; they must
be false and never fire. Hook CPIs are made in `Normal` mode only.

fields.name: before_open
docs: Veto point: a non-zero return refuses the open.

fields.name: after_open
docs: Notification after the open is booked; the pool account bytes carry the post-open state.

fields.name: reserved_2
docs: Retired (was `before_cancel`). Must be false.

fields.name: reserved_3
docs: Retired (was `after_cancel`). Must be false.

fields.name: before_deposit
docs: Veto point: a non-zero return refuses the deposit.

fields.name: after_deposit
docs: Notification after the deposit is booked; the pool account bytes carry the post-deposit state.

fields.name: reserved_6
docs: Retired (was `before_withdraw`). Must be false.

fields.name: reserved_7
docs: Retired (was `after_settle`). Must be false.

types.name: OperatingMode
docs: Kill switch and graceful degradation, designed in from day one.

fields.name: book_pay
docs: Open book aggregates (ADR-008, ADR-017 section 2), kept per leg since external scan 1 (M-4): the pay-fixed
side and the receive-fixed side are clamped to their own collateral separately, so an unbounded gain on
one side can never be netted against an uncollectible loss on the other. Each side is signed with +1 for
pay-fixed and -1 for receive-fixed swaps and maintained exactly by `open` (add) and `close` (subtract), so
the unrealised value of the book is an O(1) function of the benchmark accrual, the published value and
the clock; see `Pool::book_value`. Units: notional in USDC base units, times basis-point-seconds or seconds.

fields.name: collateral_pay
docs: Trader collateral held per side; `collateral_held` is their sum.

fields.name: limited_window_start
docs: Limited-mode budget window (simulation S-2): new notional opened in this pool since `limited_window_start`
may not exceed `Global::limited_mode_cap` within `LIMITED_WINDOW_SECS`, in addition to the per-swap cap.

fields.name: fees_buyback_accrued
docs: Unswept platform fees held in this pool's vault, buyback half (review F-29, ADR-001, ADR-013). Fees
accrue per pool so the hot path never writes the singleton `Global` or a shared fee account.

fields.name: fees_treasury_accrued
docs: Unswept platform fees held in this pool's vault, treasury half.

fields.name: withdraw_reserved
docs: USDC set aside in the vault for processed, unclaimed queued withdrawals (ADR-009). Not LP capital.

fields.name: ladder
docs: Maturity ladder (external scan 1, M-5): open swaps counted by maturity day. Maturities fall on UTC
midnights, so a day bucket is exact: once a bucket's midnight has passed and its count is not zero, a
matured swap is awaiting settlement and LP pricing is suspended until it is settled (anyone may settle it
and is paid a bounty for doing so). Bucket `day % MATURITY_BUCKETS` holds six little-endian bytes: the
`u32` day it counts and a `u16` count, so a stale bucket is detected rather than aliased. Raw bytes rather
than typed arrays so that loading the account is a copy, not a per-element decode (stack frame bound).

fields.name: share_supply
docs: Mirror of the share mint supply, so that paths without the mint account (`trader_open_swap`) can value
queued shares (M-18). Asserted equal to the mint wherever the mint is present.

fields.name: queued_shares
docs: Mirror of the withdrawal queue's open epoch (M-18): shares queued and the slot of the epoch's first
request, zero when none. A new swap may not consume the capacity an eligible epoch is waiting for.

fields.name: reserve_placed
docs: USDC principal placed at the pool's reserve venue (the Stacked Treasuries reserve, `PoolReserve`). It is
LP capital that is not in the vault, so conservation counts it: `vault + reserve_placed >= accounted`.
Zero for a pool without a reserve.

fields.name: reserve_active
docs: 1 once `admin_enable_reserve` has created the pool's `PoolReserve`; payouts then report a short working
balance by name instead of failing inside the token program.

types.name: Pricer
docs: Which pricing curve quotes this pool. `External` is reserved for v1.1 (pricer CPI); creating such a pool
is permitted so governance can stage it, but quotes fail with `PricerMismatch` until the CPI path ships.

fields.name: trader
docs: System-owned PDA that is the trader on the swap and the owner on the venue.

fields.name: deposits
docs: USDC subscribed and still in the series (before the hedge) or hedged (after it).

fields.name: min_fixed_bp
docs: The lowest fixed rate the hedge may commit the series to, in basis points. Set at creation.

fields.name: index_e18
docs: USDC per receipt base unit, scaled by 1e18.

fields.name: bench_accrual_e18
docs: The benchmark's cumulative accrual at the last touch.

fields.name: tail_bps
docs: Accrual counted at the last touch beyond the benchmark's last publication, in bp seconds.

fields.name: principal
docs: USDC placed and not yet redeemed.

fields.name: receipts
docs: Receipt supply mirror.

fields.name: funded
docs: USDC added to the reserve by `fund`, cumulative.

fields.name: anchor_index_e18
docs: The index at 00:00 UTC of `anchor_day`, exact: the compounding anchor every reading is reconstructed from.

fields.name: anchor_day
docs: UTC day number of the anchor midnight; zero on a version 1 account until its first accrual under this
build, which places the anchor from the stored index.

fields.name: anchor_accrual
docs: The benchmark's cumulative accrual at the anchor midnight, in `accrual_e18` units.

types.name: VernierParamsOnChain
docs: Vernier parameters as stored on chain (mirror of `vernier::Params`).
